title: AI Speed Test: 19 Seconds vs 7 Minutes
description:
We gave three AIs the same five coding jobs, one try each. Gemini 3.8 Flash took 434 s in total and made all five work. gpt-oss-120b took about 19 s and 4 of 5 worked (the solar system never moved). gpt-oss-20b took about 16 s and 4 of 5 worked (the hexagon had 1 ball, not 10). Times are each model's generation time from our run logs; pass or fail was judged from screen recordings. One try per job on 16 November 2026, so results can change between runs and as models update. A fourth model, Qwen 3.8 27B, could not be scored on our tier.

Full test: on our channel
